# Gautam Singh — Developer & Designer

> Independent developer and designer building custom full-stack websites, Shopify and WordPress stores, 3D web experiences, and AI automation for ambitious brands. Based in India, working worldwide.

## About

Gautam Singh is a freelance web developer and designer. He builds bespoke, custom-coded websites and applications — no templates, no page-builders. Work spans custom e-commerce, Shopify and WordPress (standard, customized, or headless), full web apps, interactive 3D experiences, and AI automation (chatbots, concierges, workflow automations). Approach: move fast on the build, but ship something solid and well-engineered underneath.

## Services

- Custom full-stack website development (Next.js, React, TypeScript)
- Shopify store design and development — standard, customized, or fully headless
- WordPress website design and development — standard, customized, or headless
- Custom e-commerce platforms built from scratch
- Web applications designed and built end to end
- Interactive 3D website experiences (Three.js, Spline, GSAP)
- AI automation: chatbots, concierges, and workflow automations

## Selected work

- [Vanta](https://vanta-ecom-store.vercel.app/): a custom streetwear e-commerce platform built from scratch — its own admin CMS, customer accounts, saved bags, wishlist, and an optimized image pipeline. Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Postgres/Prisma, Framer Motion.
- [Aether Motors](https://aether-ev.vercel.app/): a cinematic showroom for a premium EV brand — a live 3D hero, GSAP scroll choreography, inventory browsing, test-drive booking, and an AI concierge. Stack: Next.js, Spline 3D, GSAP, Lenis, Supabase.
